explanation: The original advances the handle's read cursor after the copy (v7 = v4 + a3[2]; clamped, a3[2] = v7 at recovered/native/hexrays-all/chunk_013.c:6105-6107) and returns the number of bytes copied (return v4 at chunk_013.c:6108), while the reconstruction neither stores h->pos_ nor returns the count (line 70 returns 0), so every fs_read_func call re-reads from the same offset and reports no bytes read - streamed file/asset reads (gameswf) stall or loop.

On the success path the original returns the copied payload size (return *((_DWORD *)this + 3), the size at +0x0c, recovered/native/hexrays-all/chunk_052.c:15259) but the reconstruction always returns -1, and CEventQueueBase::GetEventData forwards that value (c_event_queue_base.cpp:22-24), so every delivered event looks like a missing/failed event to its consumers.
